lsc_isolation.definition: Being cut off from other people without choosing it, and without the comfort that solitude brings.
lsc_isolation.example: Working from home every day turned into isolation by February.

pump_submersible_pump.definition: A pump whose motor is sealed in a case that works under water.
pump_submersible_pump.example: A submersible pump hangs on a cable inside the well.

ritual.definition: A repeated act that carries meaning beyond its content, such as a Friday call or a Sunday lunch.
ritual.example: The ritual is the point. The restaurant does not matter.

sharing.definition: Letting somebody use your things, and letting them do things with you too.
sharing.example: We shared the ball all afternoon.

sprout.definition: A baby plant that has just come out of the soil. Very small, very green.
sprout.example: A green sprout appeared above the soil.

war_politics.definition: The business of running a state and its relations with other states; in the theory of war, the purpose that fighting is meant to serve.
war_politics.example: The war had a political purpose, so the settlement had to satisfy the politics.
